seeds.rules: NY09:30-16:00; freeze first5mOHLC. Up candle arms longH+tick; down arms shortL-tick; doji skip. One trade/day, exit16:00. Stop ceil-to-tick0.10xmean true range of prior14 completed daily sessions. Future quote and gap/slippage rules required.
seeds.adaptation: Stock evidence does not transfer to futures; tick buffer and futures implementation are hypotheses.

seeds.rules: At15:30NY sign of price/priorRTH16:00close-1, next causal quote entry, exit16:00. No reentry/target. Protective stop1xATR of last20 completed5m bars is an added hypothesis. Requires timezone/session calendar and earlier close evidence.

Check10:00 then30min through15:30NY. Prior14sessions mean absolute same-clock return from09:30 supplies m. U=max(todayopen,priorRTHclose)*(1+m), L=min*(1-m). Long above max(U,VWAP), short below min(L,VWAP); next quote. Structural band/VWAP stop and ratchet/session exit are explicit adaptations. Real trade volume required, not FX tick volume.
